# Beseam

> Beseam shows where products lose shoppers across discovery and the store, connects the evidence that may explain it, helps teams decide and make supported changes, and measures what changed in behavior, conversion, orders, and revenue.

Beseam is not a replacement for Shopify, analytics, ad platforms, or other systems of record. It works across them and keeps source evidence attached through Observe → Understand → Decide → Act → Learn.

## Core pages

- [Platform](https://beseam.com/platform): What Beseam connects and the Observe → Understand → Decide → Act → Learn operating loop.
- [Manifesto](https://beseam.com/manifesto): Product principles, boundaries, and why Beseam is being built.
- [About](https://beseam.com/about): Founder, advisors, and company background.
- [Resources](https://beseam.com/resources): Beseam Fieldbook problems, skills, playbooks, and projects.
- [Benchmarks](https://beseam.com/benchmarks): Published commerce/discovery benchmarks when a real benchmark run is available.
- [Compare](https://beseam.com/compare): Evidence-led comparisons with analytics, behavior, optimization, and commerce platforms.

## What Beseam connects

- Discovery: AI shopping answers, search, feeds, and other pre-visit product-discovery signals.
- Store: onsite search, merchandising, product pages, recommendations, and product/catalog evidence.
- Behavior: shopper journeys, friction, checkout, and observed storefront behavior.
- Revenue: conversion, orders, attribution, and impact evidence used to measure what changed.

## Product principles

- Preserve source evidence and freshness instead of hiding it behind one opaque score.
- Separate observed facts from hypotheses and likely causes.
- Decide which commercial question deserves attention instead of producing the longest list of findings.
- Keep material customer-facing changes under explicit merchant control.
- Measure the relevant signals again after an action.

## Important boundaries

- Not every capability or data source is enabled for every store.
- Beseam does not claim an exact cause when evidence supports only correlation or a hypothesis.
- AI-answer observations are point-in-time samples and do not reveal hidden model ranking logic.
- No recommendation, traffic, conversion, or revenue outcome is guaranteed.
